faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HAL Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the HAL Trade Apprentice posts is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Craftsmen Training from recognized ITIs of Karnataka state to be eligible for the Trade Apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Trade Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 9600 to Rs. 10560.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Trade Apprentice post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Trade Apprentice post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the HAL Trade Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the HAL Trade Apprentice recruitment is based on Merit.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the HAL recruitment located?
faq.answer: The HAL recruitment is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560017.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is F/TTI-B/02:SEL/0849/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply for this post?
faq.answer: The qualification mentioned is "Craftsmen Training from recognized ITIs of Karnataka state," implying that candidates should have completed their training from ITIs within Karnataka.
